text:
elaine (Sales): heads up — Acme wants a BYO‑HSM POC. Requirements: offline key ceremony, quarterly rotations, HSM attestation reports, audit log forwarding into their SIEM, and no plaintext leaving their VPC. They want price, runbook, and a 4‑week POC timeline. Any immediate blockers?
sam (SE): quick q — will they proxy through our key‑proxy or do direct HSM calls from our private nodes? also need expected QPS and max token length for perf sizing.
marta (CryptoOps): offline ceremony is fine. For BYO we'll provide a mock ceremony runbook + scripts, but we need network ACLs to allow attestation callbacks and our attestation verifier IPs. Rotation every 90 days ok — note that for BYO HSM automated rotation requires their operator to run the final key import step. Latency impact: expect ~5–12ms extra per request for remote KMS hops (depends on region).
ben (Eng): Dedicated pool recommended for consistent latency. If they want hosted fallback we can route to a cached key variant but that changes risk model. Also: enable prefix KV caching to reduce KMS calls during long chats.
legal-bot: prefilled answers for the security questionnaire (section: CMK handling) uploaded: https://redwood.internal/sq/answers/acme-cmk. We state: "Redwood does not store customer plaintext keys; keys reside in customer HSM or KMIP endpoint." Make sure SOC evidence links are attached.
customer_pmo (Acme PM): couple of asks from procurement — is rotation included in ongoing fees? and is there an HSM connector license? any proration for POC?
elaine (Sales): ballpark numbers: POC SOW $15k (includes 2 SEs + 2 CryptoOps days, runbook, and on‑call support). HSM connector license $2k/mo for BYO connectors (covers support/attestation tooling). Rotation automation dev included in POC scope but long‑term automation is part of ent. license — will confirm SOW line items.
sam (SE): draft runbook snippet (for ops team) —
```
# mock ceremony steps
1) customer exports attestation CSR from HSM
2) SE ingests CSR on staging node: ./tools/attest --ingest csr.pem
3) run import -> ./tools/import-key --wrap-with-rw-kek key.blob
4) validate audit forwarding: curl -s https://siem.acme/internal -X POST -d @logs.json
```
marta (CryptoOps): note: attestation validation needs their vendor cert chain and a signed artifact. We'll need their HSM vendor (CloudHSM vs Thales) to pull the right verifier. Also request: provide their auditor contact for evidentiary trace.
ben (Eng): ops note — if they opt for CloudHSM remote, we need VPC peering + specific SGs. Expect a networking lead time of ~3 business days for firewall rules.
elaine (Sales): next steps I propose: 1) confirm HSM vendor & region, 2) sign POC SOW, 3) schedule mock ceremony wk of Apr 14, 4) exchange auditor contact + CMS endpoints. @customer_pmo can you confirm dates?
customer_pmo (Acme PM): Apr 17 works for the ceremony. Also confirm: customer maintenance window requirement — they asked <2hr monthly maintenance. Is that acceptable?
ben (Eng): yes — we'll mark ASAP maintenance windows off-peak and commit to <2hr routine maintenance. SLA credits apply if exceeded.
marta (CryptoOps): one more blocker — their security team requires HSM attestation report within 24h of ceremony. Can we commit to producing that?
elaine (Sales): we can commit to delivering attestation report within 48h as part of POC. For enterprise contract we can push for 24h SLT. I'll flag with Acme.
customer_pmo (Acme PM): 48h acceptable for POC. Please send updated SOW with the 48h attestation deliverable and a brief network runbook.
elaine (Sales): will do — prepping updated SOW and S3 link to runbook by EOD. tagging @sam @marta for final review. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: automated note — staging environment for acme‑poc created: infra-acme-stg-03 ready (link: https://deploys.redwood/staging/infra-acme-stg-03).
sam (SE): picking up action items: I'll add the runbook network snippet and the exact perf impact numbers for CloudHSM vs on‑prem. Expect updated doc by tomorrow morning.
marta (CryptoOps): I'll draft the attestation checklist + evidence template and attach to SOW.
elaine (Sales): thanks team — I'll confirm pricing lines and send to procurement.
